subject: maths
question: Kapil rows 2 {{1} over 2} km against the current in 15 minutes and the same distance along the current in 8 minutes. What is the speed (in km/h) of the current?
solution:
**Given:**

Kapil rows 2 {{1} over 2} km against the current in 15 minutes

Kapil rows 2 {{1} over 2} km along the current in 8 minutes

**Concept used:**

Speed = D/t

Upstream = u - v

Downstream = u + v

u = speed of the object

v = speed of the current

**Calculation:**

Speed of upstream = 5/2 × 60/15 = 10 km/h

Speed of downstream = 5/2 × 60/8 = 18.75 km/h

So,

u + v = 18.75 ----(i)

u - v = 10 ----(ii)

By subtracting (ii) from (i) we get,

⇒ 2v = 8.75

⇒ v = 8.75/2 or 35/8

**∴ The speed (in km/h) of the current 35/8**
